description: This file defines the CircularByteBuffer class, a thread-unsafe implementation of a circular buffer for byte data, including methods for reading and writing bytes, and managing the buffer state.

classes.name: CircularByteBuffer
classes.description: A thread-unsafe circular byte buffer that allows for reading and writing bytes in a fixed-size buffer with wrap-around logic.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the buffer to an empty state, setting length and pointers to zero.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the current number of bytes stored in the buffer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the next byte from the buffer, throwing EOFException if the buffer is empty.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a byte to the buffer, throwing BufferOverflowException if the buffer is full.
